title: The Adventures
subtitle: I want to burrow into every tree hole, sneak through every night—I want to run, I want to scream, I want to jump higher!

items.text: The Adventures

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Dear Harald—”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Grown-ups often say that torches will extinguish, great trees will wither, and even the endless feasts will eventually end in a great mess.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: "’Heroes too will have their curtain call,’ they say earnestly, solemnly, unwilling to move even for the remote control that they’re sitting on.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Grown-ups act like they know everything, issuing commands like they’re kings and queens. But what do they know, really?”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Maybe they've only sneaked a peek at the door to glory and pride.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “They say, ‘don't climb too high.’”

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Get down from that tree right now, you rascals. Or else... I'll make you fall!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: We're not coming down until we catch that Huma bird! I’m sure it’ll appear at dusk.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: It’s said that if you feed them toenails and smelly boots for three days, they’ll grant you a wish. I'll make them eat all the test papers so we won't have any more exams!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: I—I want it to find the book the instructor threw away.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Damn, you little troublemakers. I'm coming up!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: No, no, don't! This tree can't take anymore— Ah—!

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho & Effie
items.text: Ahh—!

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “They say, ‘don't think too much.’”

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: ...Will the ghost really come? I'm getting sleepy.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: It will, I’m sure of it! They say that the ghost of that missing student appears here on the night of every full moon...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: And if we find him, he’ll reveal the exam questions for next week!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Okay, well, I’m going to lay down and sleep for a bit until he—

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text:
(Patter, patter) Look! 
The ghost is here.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text:
The moon is just perfect tonight...♫
Hum-dee-dum, now to take out my orbuculum.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Huh? Who's there!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text:
Ahh—!
Run!

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “They say, ‘don't run too fast.’”

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text:
In this lesson, you will learn how to deal with a glavakus.
Now, I will release a domestically bred...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text:
Ahhhh— My cloak! 
Sailors, stop it!

items.speaker: Glawackus
items.text: Roaaar!

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Jarl, quick! Stop now—!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: It follows loud, fast-moving things—!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: I can't—hear—you!

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: "Don't climb too high, don't think too much, don't run too fast, don't be too selfish, don't wander too far, don't go... on adventures!"

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “If we listened to these grown-ups, all those amazing treasures, great feats, and countless heroic tales would end up like the remote control under their butts: lost in the couch forever!”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “So, my dear Harald—I've gathered a crew of SPDM students with extraordinary abilities to lead a rebellion against all these boring grown-ups.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text:
“They are loyal and dedicated to me.”
”They have remained unflinching; even in the face of the nasty witch.”

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: I swear, it was me who ate the fish and chips. I ate it all on my own!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: (Patter, patter) Jarl, the corner of your mouth...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: Letter
items.text:
“They possess the wisdom of Mimir and the agility of Thor.”
”Even the craftiest of witches are helpless against them.”

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hey, what's that bulging in your pocket?

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: It’s, uh, it's...

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: —It's the stinky, chewy chunk I gave her!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: You wouldn't want to fish it out with your hand. It'll make you so sick that you won’t be able to eat the whole night long!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Sniff, sniff...

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Even in the most critical moments—”

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hey—hey! Isn't that Miss Sonetto?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hmm? What?! P-Perhaps she needs the help of an outstanding disciplinary assistant!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I-I'll be right back!

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: My crew and I always find a way out.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "I have to say, my heart is bursting with excitement!"

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "My dear Harald, I can't wait to show you everything I've achieved here."

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Also, how is my crew at Stillwater Lake doing? Did Dumb Howard take over the park? Did Old John find the note I stuck on the bumper of his car? Ha-ha-ha, he must have been furious..."

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Also, I got the chewing gum you sent. My crew absolutely loves it."

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Also, how come your handwriting looks so much neater? Is Aunt Sigrid from next door writing your letters for you?"

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Hah, she's got you all figured out!"

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Anyway, I hope everything is well with you."

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "Well, I'm off to sleep! This 'Introduction to Alchemy' book is as heavy as a rock and gives me a headache."

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: "—Missing you, Erick."
TO BE CONTINUED…
